name: epithelial cell adhesion molecule
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: EPCAM encodes epithelial cell adhesion molecule. Annotated molecular activities include cadherin binding involved in cell-cell adhesion. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and signal transduction involved in regulation of gene expression.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Lynch syndrome (autosomal dominant); Lynch syndrome 8 (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
